svg.aria-label: Harsha Pilli, Java and Spring Boot developer in Halifax, Nova Scotia. Three years of production delivery before a Master of Applied Computer Science at Dalhousie University. Available for a 4 or 8 month developer co-op from January 2027, open to relocation anywhere in Canada.

g.text: Java · Spring Boot · REST APIs · Cloud
Three years of production delivery before the
degree, not after it. Now completing a Master of
Applied Computer Science at Dalhousie University
in Halifax, and looking for a 4- or 8-month
Four projects, and what is measurably in them.
layered services, serving three portals from one
backend. 535 JUnit 5 tests, all written test-first.
Both clouds provisioned as code, rebuildable from
a clean account. MFA stages two and three, the
booking Lambda, SQS to SNS reminders. Team of 7.
Six categories of SonarCloud code smell cleared
across 16 files, +539/-134 over nine commits, held
to project conventions through maintainer review.
Everything below is in a shipped project or three years of paid work.
